name: Augusta's Custom Fab and Build Inc.
old_description: "Fabricating Ideas to Build Dreams" welding and fabrication services
about:
Augusta's Custom Fab and Build Inc. operates from Gretna, Louisiana, serving the greater New Orleans area with welding and fabrication services. The company does not publish a founding year, and ownership details such as family or veteran status are not disclosed on its website.

The shop provides custom and specialty welding alongside fabrication of commercial and residential handrails, guardrails, and fencing. Work is quoted either by the hour for welding services or by the foot for linear installations such as railing and fencing. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers span both commercial and residential sectors, with projects ranging from custom welding jobs to installed railing and fence systems. The company does not list specific industry verticals beyond these two broad categories.

The business emphasizes timely, professional workmanship and aims to complete jobs correctly on the first attempt and on the customer's schedule. A promotional discount of 10 percent is offered to new customers on any service.
